# Generated by mods/where_to_produce/tools/generate.py. Do not edit by hand.
#
# Whether the map picker and the ranking offer this location at all.
#
# The ticked continents narrow it; with nothing ticked the whole world is on
# offer, because a picker that shows nothing until a checkbox somewhere else is
# set looks broken rather than empty. Ownership is deliberately never asked --
# the whole use is planning for ground that is not yours yet.
#
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_in_zone = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			global_var:bag_wtp_zone_count = 0
			global_var:bag_wtp_region_count = 0
		}
		region = { is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_regions target = this } }
		AND = {
			continent = continent:europe
			is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_continents target = continent:europe }
		}
		AND = {
			continent = continent:asia
			is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_continents target = continent:asia }
		}
		AND = {
			continent = continent:africa
			is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_continents target = continent:africa }
		}
		AND = {
			continent = continent:america
			is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_continents target = continent:america }
		}
		AND = {
			continent = continent:oceania
			is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_continents target = continent:oceania }
		}
	}
}
